html.この7本だけで、第8回で出てきた「たすき掛け」の理由が分かります。⭐<b>ハイビ: These seven alone explain the “crossed” pattern from Part 8. ⭐ The high-beam current comes in from after the side-light fuses (F5, F6). 30/3 (from F5) goes to the left high beam, 30/2 (from F6) to the right one. So when one fuse blows, “the high beam on one side” and “the side lights on the opposite side” go out together — the combination we saw in Part 8 is made right here.
